title: Haroon v. State of U.P. and others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta and Prashant Kumar, JJ.
disposition: Petition disposed after recovery withdrawn; fresh Supply Code order after hearing.
headnote: The Electricity Department withdrew the recovery citation dated 21.02.2023 and undertook to pass a fresh order after hearing the petitioner. The writ was disposed of with liberty to the respondents to proceed afresh strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. No clause of the Code was construed.
facts: Haroon filed a writ petition in the Allahabad High Court challenging a recovery citation dated 21 February 2023 issued by respondent no. 4 for electricity dues. On 28 March 2023 counsel for the Electricity Department sought time to obtain instructions, and the petition was directed to be listed on 4 April 2023. On that date the Department's counsel stated that the impugned recovery had been withdrawn and that a fresh order would be passed after the petitioner was heard.

holding_units.topic: Fresh proceedings after withdrawal of a recovery citation
holding_units.holding: On the Electricity Department's statement that the recovery citation dated 21.02.2023 had been withdrawn and that a fresh order would follow an opportunity of hearing, the writ was disposed of with liberty to the respondents to proceed afresh strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
holding_units.flag: Order names the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 but states no clause number.

principle_tags.application: The citation having been withdrawn, with an undertaking to hear the petitioner and pass a fresh order, the writ was closed and any further action was reserved to the procedure under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

not_decided.point: Whether the electricity dues covered by the recovery citation dated 21.02.2023 were payable by the petitioner.
not_decided.note: The citation was withdrawn. The court did not examine the demand and left the respondents to pass a fresh order after hearing, if they proceeded under the Supply Code, 2005.
